Twin Health is a pioneering digital health company dedicated to transforming the management and prevention of chronic metabolic diseases such as type 2 diabetes and obesity. By leveraging innovative AI Digital Twin technology, Twin Health creates personalized metabolic models for each individual, utilizing data from continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), smartwatches, meal logs, and other health metrics. This approach enables tailored treatment plans that empower members to achieve significant health improvements, including lowering A1C levels below diabetic ranges, attaining sustainable weight loss, and reducing or eliminating medications. Recognized for its innovation and positive workplace culture, Twin Health has received numerous accolades, including Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable, inclusion in CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and being named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplaces. With substantial funding from leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, Twin Health is rapidly scaling its impact across the United States and globally, aiming to set a new standard of care in metabolic health.
About The Role
We are seeking an experienced AI Automation QA Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess extensive manual testing skills combined with expertise in AI-driven test automation. This role involves developing comprehensive regression test coverage for complex web and mobile applications, ensuring the highest quality standards in a fast-paced enterprise or startup environment. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to derive detailed test plans, design and implement AI-enhanced automated testing strategies, and contribute to evaluating and validating internally developed models. Additionally, this role involves automating data generation for testing scenarios, collaborating with developers, product managers, and UX designers to deliver an exceptional user experience, and continuously evolving testing infrastructure to leverage agentic AI capabilities for rapid test generation and healing. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a cutting-edge health technology company committed to innovation and impactful solutions in metabolic health.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
Minimum of 3 years of experience in QA engineering with a focus on test automation
Proven experience testing web UIs and mobile applications (iOS, Android, Flutter)
Strong programming skills in Java, Python, or JavaScript
Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Playwright, Maestro, Appium, or Selenium
Solid understanding of SQL databases and experience with test data generation
Experience testing REST API backends for high-scale consumer applications
Familiarity with automated performance testing tools like jMeter or Locust
Experience developing AI-driven regression automation using models like Claude or similar
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities
Experience building and maintaining evaluation frameworks for internal models is a plus
Knowledge of healthcare, biosensors, or conversational agent validation is a plus
Responsibilities
Collaborate with stakeholders to derive comprehensive end-to-end regression test cases and test plans covering critical application functionalities
Design, implement, and maintain robust AI-driven automated regression test suites for web and mobile applications
Contribute to the evaluation and validation of internally developed models, ensuring accuracy and reliability
Develop AI-enabled automated testing strategies, including rapid prompt-driven test generation and test healing techniques
Design and develop automated data generation processes to support testing scenarios
Work closely with developers, product managers, and UX designers to ensure seamless delivery of a high-quality user experience across the integrated application ecosystem
Continuously improve testing infrastructure by integrating new AI tools and methodologies
Participate in troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving automation issues
Document testing processes, results, and improvements for ongoing quality assurance
Perform other duties as assigned to support project goals and team success
Benefits
Competitive annual salary ranging from $130,000 to $140,000 USD
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance fully sponsored by the employer for employees, with 80% coverage for family members
Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
401(k) retirement savings plan with company contributions
Remote work flexibility with a collaborative global team
Opportunity for equity participation in a rapidly growing innovative company
Unlimited vacation policy subject to managerial approval
Paid parental leave: 16 weeks fully paid for delivering parents and 8 weeks for non-delivering parents
Access to cutting-edge health technology and participation in impactful projects
Supportive and inclusive work environment fostering professional growth and development
Equal Opportunity
Twin Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability status, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds drive innovation and excellence, and we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our mission of improving metabolic health worldwide.

We are hiring builders to define how people talk to, show things to, and hear from AI
In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We've scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action.
The Multimodal team builds the experiences and infrastructure that move AI interaction beyond touch and text — realtime voice, vision, and the platform systems behind them. We own the full path from a user speaking into a device to an answer coming back: the realtime session infrastructure that connects clients to frontier audio models, the backend orchestration that routes, records, and supervises live sessions, and the SDK that powers voice and multimodal experiences across Perplexity's apps.
As a backend engineer on Multimodal, you will design and scale the distributed systems that carry live voice sessions in production — and drive entirely new products at the intersection of voice, vision, and agents.
Why Perplexity is Different
Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious.
Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it.
Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users.
Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products.
Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence.
What you'll do
Design, build, and scale the backend session-worker architecture that powers realtime voice: durable per-session workers, provider routing, and stateful streaming over gRPC.
Own distributed-systems problems end-to-end — session lifecycle, crash recovery, reconnection and replay, multi-region deployment, and graceful degradation under real production load.
Build provider-agnostic streaming protocols from our backend to the Rust SDK that powers voice across every client stack.
Drive new products and initiatives in voice and multimodal AI from problem definition through technical design, implementation, and launch.
Build the orchestration layer that lets live voice models delegate work to tools, agents, and long-running tasks — safely, asynchronously, and at scale.
Partner closely with SDK, client, infrastructure, and model teams; work across the stack when the product demands it, from backend services to client-facing APIs.
What we're looking for
4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend or distributed systems.
Strong experience in Rust, Python, or Go (we work primarily in Rust and Python).
Experience designing and operating production distributed systems: streaming RPC (gRPC or similar), stateful services, message-driven architectures, and failure recovery.
Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure — deploying, scaling, and operating services on AWS or equivalent.
Strong product judgment and the ability to translate user problems into simple, effective technical solutions.
Genuine interest and adoption of AI products and willingness to learn quickly.
Nice to have
Experience with realtime media systems: voice, audio streaming, WebRTC, or low-latency transport.
Full-stack range — comfort building end-to-end, from backend services through client SDKs or web frontends.
Experience integrating LLMs, speech models, or computer vision into production systems.
Experience with agent frameworks, tool-calling architectures, or sandboxed execution environments.
Time spent at a fast-growing startup or on a high-ownership engineering team.
Our Mission
Perplexity’s mission is to power curiosity. Curious people are the people who drive change in the world. Driving change is a continuous cycle of learning, building, and integrating.
Learn
: curious people constantly learn new things by asking more. They question the status quo in their own expertise and they constantly learn outside of it. Research is essential to them and never ending.
Build
: curious people make and create things, to show the world their new answers to problems no one else ever questioned. They take action on what they’ve learned. Makers need tools to create their products, their companies, their reality.
Integrate
: they must interact with the world as it is to drive change and adoption. True leaders do not simply build something and hope. They must have armies of agents and workers who can constantly work in millions of small ways.
Repeat
. For curious people this is a cycle that never ends.
Compensation Range: $220K - $405K

description_preview:
Member of Technical Staff, Alignment — Airlock
About the job
Airlock is building the security infrastructure for AI agents.
As AI agents become increasingly autonomous, they're gaining access to sensitive data, internal systems, and critical business operations. The existing security stack wasn't built for software that can reason, make decisions, and take actions on its own. We're building the infrastructure that makes it possible for organizations to deploy AI agents securely and at scale.
We're a small, highly technical team backed by Y Combinator. We move quickly, prioritize engineering excellence, and believe the best engineers thrive when given ownership over difficult problems. Everyone is expected to be hands-on, contribute directly to the product, and take ideas from conception to production.
We're looking for people who are intellectually curious, move with urgency, and care deeply about building great systems.
About the Role
Airlock is seeking exceptional engineers to build the next generation of security infrastructure for AI agents.
In this role, you'll work on some of the hardest problems at the intersection of AI, security, and systems engineering. You'll design infrastructure that gives organizations visibility into how their AI agents operate, control what those agents can access, and protect sensitive information as it moves across tools, services, and environments.
You'll work across the stack, from building high-performance proxies and authorization systems to developing security analysis engines, agent integrations, and intuitive developer-facing products.
As an early engineer, you'll have significant ownership over technical decisions, work directly with the founders, and help define the architecture of systems that will secure the next generation of software.
Focus
Candidates for this role may focus on one or more of the following:
Agent Security Infrastructure:
Building high-performance proxies, gateways, and runtime integrations to monitor and enforce security policies across AI agents, MCP servers, and external tools.
Access Control & Authorization:
Developing granular permission systems that control what agents can access and which actions they can perform across enterprise applications, databases, and internal services.
Information Flow & Security Analysis:
Building systems to track sensitive information across agents, tools, and connected infrastructure, identify exposure paths, and detect potential security vulnerabilities.
AI Security Research & Engineering:
Developing automated techniques to discover vulnerabilities in AI-powered applications, evaluate adversarial attacks, and defend against prompt injection, privilege escalation, and data exfiltration.
Observability & Developer Tools:
Building execution tracing, exposure graphs, and security visualizations that help developers understand, debug, and secure complex multi-agent systems.
Ideal Experience
The ideal candidate:
Has exceptional software engineering skills, with strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, or similar languages.
Has experience building complex backend systems, developer infrastructure, or security tooling.
Understands distributed systems, networking, APIs, and fundamental security concepts.
Is comfortable working across different layers of the stack and learning unfamiliar technologies when necessary.
Enjoys solving ambiguous, technically challenging problems and can independently take projects from idea to production.
Has strong technical judgment, communicates clearly, and takes pride in the quality of their work.
Is highly motivated, moves quickly, and wants to help build a company from the ground up.
Experience with AI agents, MCP, authorization systems, runtime security, program analysis, or LLM security is a plus, but not required. We care far more about your ability to learn quickly and solve difficult problems than whether you've worked with a particular technology before.
Interview Process
We value demonstrated engineering ability over credentials and aim to keep our interview process fast, practical, and technically rigorous.
Virtual Onsite consisting of:
Technical Interview:
A practical coding and problem-solving session focused on your engineering fundamentals.
Systems & Architecture:
A discussion around designing and reasoning about real-world infrastructure, security, or distributed systems.
Meet the Founders:
Walk us through something exceptional you've built, the decisions you made, and the problems you'd be excited to solve at Airlock.
Our goal is to move quickly and minimize unnecessary interview rounds.
Compensation
$250k base + equity

Design, build, and/or deliver ML models and components that solve real-world business problems, while working in collaboration with the Product and Data Science teams
Inform your ML infrastructure decisions using your understanding of ML modeling techniques and issues, including choice of model, data, and feature selection, model training, hyperparameter tuning, dimensionality, bias/variance, and validation)
Solve complex problems by writing and testing application code, developing and validating ML models, and automating tests and deployment
Collaborate as part of a cross-functional Agile team to create and enhance software that enables state-of-the-art big data and ML applications
Retrain, maintain, and monitor models in production
Leverage or build cloud-based architectures, technologies, and/or platforms to deliver optimized ML models at scale.
Construct optimized data pipelines to feed ML models
Leverage continuous integration and continuous deployment best practices, including test automation and monitoring, to ensure successful deployment of ML models and application code
Ensure all code is well-managed to reduce vulnerabilities, models are well-governed from a risk perspective, and the ML follows best practices in Responsible and Explainable AI
Use programming languages like Python, Scala, or Java
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
At least 3 years of experience programming with Python, Java, Golang, or C++
At least 2 years of Machine Learning experience using industry standard frameworks PyTorch or Tensorflow and libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
At least 3 years of experience using and operating large scale distributed systems (Spark, Ray) to prepare AI/ML data
At least 1 year of experience deploying and operating Machine Learning solutions in production and operating production services in the cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and using Kubernetes to manage large scale containerized ML software systems
Preferred Qualifications:
Master's or Doctoral Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related field
1+ years of experience optimizing ML algorithms, configurations, and infrastructure
1+ years of experience following software development best practices including source control, testing, code reviews, CI/CD, etc.
1+ years of experience building resilient software solutions with pre-production testing, advanced deployment techniques (one-box, blue/green, gradual dial-up), monitoring, alarms, and preparing incident response plans
1+ years of experience working with Machine Learning techniques (Supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised, reinforcement learning, etc.) model types (Regression, Classification, Clustering, etc.), model Architectures (RNNs, CNNs, LSTMs, Transformers), training concepts (loss function, hyperparameters, regularization), and how to evaluate model accuracy and diagnose and address common issues (underfitting, overfitting)
Authored/co-authored a paper on a ML technique, model, or proof of concept
1+ years of experience designing, implementing, and scaling production-ready data pipelines for training and evaluating ML models

or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer
).

The organization operates in the finance technology sector, focusing on automating accounts payable processes. The company's platform integrates with various enterprise systems and is expanding its reach into the retail and grocery markets.

The SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SMS ADAPTER is responsible for developing and maintaining a critical software connector that integrates store-level systems with the organization's accounts payable platform. This role ensures reliable, secure data synchronization from retail environments, enabling non-technical store operators to manage the system confidently. The position offers significant ownership and impact, contributing directly to the organization's expansion into new market sectors.

Develop and maintain the adapter connecting in-store systems to the accounts payable platform.
Design robust synchronization processes including delta and full syncs, retry mechanisms, and failure visibility.
Manage local data storage and credentials to enable secure, unattended operation.
Enhance setup and monitoring tools for store staff to configure and troubleshoot without engineering support.
Establish automated test coverage to ensure reliability across supported environments.
Handle packaging, updates, and installation for software deployed on store machines.
Collaborate with pilot customers to resolve environment-specific issues and improve product reliability.
Define and evolve data models and mappings for onboarding additional store systems.
Requirements:
Over five years of software engineering experience with end-to-end product ownership.
Experience developing software for end-user machines, including packaging and distribution.
Strong database skills, including reverse-engineering third-party schemas.
Proven ability to write dependable integration and synchronization code.
Practical knowledge of appropriate testing strategies, including integration and end-to-end tests.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving product areas.
